query:
insert into drafts
             (id, tenant_id, lab_report_id, attempt, source, model, explanations, failures, blocked, warnings, created_at)
         values ($1, $2, $3,
                 (select coalesce(max(attempt), 0) + 1 from drafts where tenant_id = $2 and lab_report_id = $3),
                 $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10)
